Sarah Jennings, CBAP
Business Analyst
Chicago, IL | (312) 555-0188 | sarah.jennings@email.com | linkedin.com/in/sarah-jennings-ba
PROFESSIONAL SUMMARY
Certified Business Analysis Professional (CBAP) with 5 years of experience bridging the gap between business
stakeholders and technical engineering units. Proven mastery in agile requirements gathering, workflow mapping
(BPMN), detailed document management (BRDs/FRDs), and structuring user acceptance testing (UAT) cycles.
Expert at using SQL and data visualization tools to isolate workflow bottlenecks and translate complex operations into
concise technical definitions.
CORE COMPETENCIES
(cid:127) Requirements Gathering (cid:127) BRD & FRD Documentation (cid:127) Agile & Scrum Methodologies
(cid:127) SQL Data Analysis (cid:127) Jira & Confluence Mastery (cid:127) Process Mapping (BPMN)
(cid:127) Tableau & Power BI (cid:127) UAT Coordination (cid:127) Cross-Functional Alignment
PROFESSIONAL EXPERIENCE
Business Analyst – Apex Financial Solutions 2023 – Present
(cid:127) Served as the primary functional liaison between executive business heads and backend software development
squads to drive digital transformation initiatives.
(cid:127) Gathered comprehensive business requirements to compile 40+ precise Business Requirement Documents (BRDs)
and Functional Requirement Documents (FRDs).
(cid:127) Utilized SQL querying and Tableau dashboards to uncover operational friction points, successfully streamlining
order workflows and boosting processing efficiency by 19%.
(cid:127) Governed User Acceptance Testing (UAT) cycles, structuring end-to-end test strategies, script execution guidelines,
and Jira defect tracking frameworks that lowered system launch bugs by 18%.
Associate Business Analyst – Core Consulting Group 2021 – 2023
(cid:127) Facilitated cross-functional sprint planning sessions, daily standups, and backlog grooming sessions under strict
Agile frameworks using Jira and Confluence.
(cid:127) Mapped complex current-state vs. future-state operating models utilizing BPMN process flow charting toolsets.
(cid:127) Coordinated with Quality Assurance leads to ensure functional criteria aligned seamlessly with initial stakeholder
requirements.
EDUCATION
Bachelor of Business Administration in Management Information Systems – Global University (2021)
Certification: Certified Business Analysis Professional (CBAP) – IIBA (2024)
